text: My mental health has improved a lot since the experience. I had been dealing with anxiety for years, mostly a kind of constant background alarm that never switched off. I thought that was just who I was. The experience showed me that there's another state possible, a deep stillness and safety, and knowing that it exists has given me hope and something to work towards. My anxiety has gone down quite a bit, and when it does flare up, I'm not as scared of it. I've also started meditating regularly, which helps me access that stillness. Beyond the anxiety, I've noticed I'm more open to experiences and people. I used to be quite guarded and judgemental, and now I'm more curious. I feel like there's more space in my mind, and more room for joy and connection. I'm genuinely grateful for this experience.

Ich bin optimistischer geworden und habe weniger Zukunftsängste. Ich glaube daran, dass sich die Dinge fügen werden, und das gibt mir Ruhe. Ich bin auch dankbarer für das, was ich habe, auch wenn noch nicht alles so ist, wie ich es mir wünsche.

My mental health has improved a lot since I started living according to my values. I was depressed in my corporate job, though I didn't really realise it until I left. Now I feel a sense of purpose and meaning that I never had before. I'm more open to different ways of living and I appreciate the simple things, like having time to cook dinner or read a book. I'm happier, calmer, and more myself.

Losing my father was very hard, but I think I came out of it in better mental health than I went into it. For years I had carried anger and resentment towards him, and I think it was affecting my mood and my relationships. I was often irritable and closed off. The experience helped me let go of a lot of that anger and see him as a human being with his own pain. That softened something in me. I'm more loving with my own kids now, and more patient with my wife. I'm also more open about my feelings, which is new for me. My therapist says I've made huge progress. I feel lighter, and I'm grateful that I got to say goodbye to my father in a good way. That wouldn't have happened without the experience. I still grieve him, but it's a clean grief, without all the bitterness mixed in.
Ich bin ausgeglichener und streite weniger mit meinen Eltern. Das tut mir psychisch sehr gut, weil diese Konflikte mich früher lange beschäftigt haben.
I'm less anxious and more resilient. I feel better about myself and my ability to handle life.

My mental health has changed in a deep way. I used to carry a lot of shame that I wasn't even aware of, and it showed up as anger, defensiveness, and periods of depression. The experience brought all of that shame to the surface, which was incredibly painful, but then it transformed into compassion. I feel much more at peace with myself now. My depressive episodes have become much less frequent. I'm also more loving and open with the people around me, especially my family. I reconnected with my brother after years of not speaking, and we're close now. I feel like a different person in many ways, more honest, more open, more able to love and be loved. I'm also more curious about other people and their stories, because I understand now that everyone carries their own pain.
Ich kenne mich besser und kann meine Gefühle besser einordnen. Dadurch bin ich psychisch stabiler und weniger impulsiv geworden.

My mental health has improved quite a lot. I used to feel a lot of anger and despair about my diabetes, and I think that contributed to depression in my twenties. Now I feel more at peace with it and even grateful for my body, which is something I never expected. I'm less depressed and more able to enjoy life. I appreciate the good days so much more. I've also become more open to talking about my illness with others, which has made me feel less alone.
Less anxious, more relaxed. I don't beat myself up so much.

Meine psychische Gesundheit hat sich durch die Erfahrung sehr verbessert. Ich stand kurz vor einem Burnout, hatte Schlafprobleme und war innerlich wie abgestorben. Ich konnte mich über nichts mehr freuen und war im Privatleben oft gereizt und abwesend. Seit der Erfahrung kann ich meine Gefühle wieder zulassen, und dadurch fühle ich mich lebendiger. Ich schlafe besser und habe wieder Energie für meine Familie und meine Hobbys. Vor allem aber spüre ich wieder Freude, an kleinen Dingen, an meinen Kindern, an der Natur. Ich bin auch dankbarer für mein eigenes Leben und meine Gesundheit, weil ich jeden Tag sehe, wie zerbrechlich das alles ist. Meine Arbeit erfüllt mich wieder, und ich habe das Gefühl, dass ich den Menschen, die ich pflege, mehr geben kann, weil ich selbst nicht mehr leer bin.
I'm less burnt out and more balanced. I'm better at taking care of myself before it's too late.

I'm kinder to myself, and that has improved my mental health a lot. I used to be very self-critical, especially when things went wrong, and that made me anxious and depressed. Now I'm more patient and accepting, and I recover from setbacks more quickly. I feel more stable and secure in myself.
Ich bin selbstbewusster geworden und lasse mich nicht mehr so leicht verunsichern. Das hat meine Stimmung verbessert, und ich fühle mich wohler in meiner Haut.

The experience was a turning point in my recovery from burnout and depression. I had been feeling completely empty for months, and nothing seemed to help. During the experience, I felt for the first time in a long time a deep sense of love, not from anyone else, but for myself, for the little boy who worked so hard. That love was healing. In the weeks after the experience, I started to feel things again. I cried a lot, but I also laughed. I started to enjoy simple things, like walking my dog or cooking. My depression lifted gradually, and I've been stable for over a year now. I understand myself much better, and I've learned to set boundaries at work and in my personal life. I feel like I have a new relationship with myself, based on care rather than achievement. I'm also more grateful for the people around me, especially my wife, who stood by me through the whole thing.
Calmer and more balanced
Ich bin weniger ängstlich und kann das Leben mehr genießen. Ich habe das Gefühl, dass ich nicht mehr so viel Kontrolle brauche, um mich sicher zu fühlen.

I'm much less lonely and depressed. Having friends has made a huge difference to my mental health. I feel connected and supported, and I'm more open to people than I used to be. I appreciate those friendships so much, and I'm grateful that I finally reached out.

The experience has been a crucial part of my recovery from anorexia, which I've struggled with since I was fourteen. My mental health has improved in many ways. I'm much less anxious around food, and my depression, which was always tied to the eating disorder, has lifted quite a bit. More than that, I've started to feel something like love for my body, or at least respect and gratitude. That's huge for me, because I hated my body for so long. I also understand myself much better now: I know that the eating disorder was a way of coping with feeling out of control and unworthy, and I'm learning other ways to cope. I'm more open to receiving help and love from others. My relationship with my parents has improved, because I've been able to talk to them honestly about what I've been through. I'm not fully recovered, but I have hope now, which I didn't have before.
Ich bin zuversichtlicher und weniger ängstlich. Ich vertraue mehr auf mich selbst.
I feel lighter and less bitter. Forgiving people has helped my mood a lot, and I feel more love in general.
Not much change in my mental health. I'm a bit more self-aware, but otherwise the same as before.

Meine psychische Gesundheit hat sich durch die Erfahrung sehr verbessert. Ich litt jahrelang an einer Angststörung, die mein ganzes Leben bestimmt hat. Ich habe viele Dinge vermieden, aus Angst, dass etwas Schlimmes passieren könnte. Seit der Erfahrung ist die Angst deutlich weniger geworden. Ich habe gelernt, dass ich mich auf das Leben verlassen kann und dass ich nicht ständig auf der Hut sein muss. Ich bin viel entspannter und kann mein Leben endlich genießen. Ich habe angefangen, Dinge zu tun, die ich mich vorher nie getraut hätte, z.B. allein zu verreisen oder einen Kurs an der Volkshochschule zu besuchen. Ich bin dankbar für jeden Tag, an dem ich mich frei fühle. Auch meine Ehe ist dadurch glücklicher geworden, weil mein Mann sich nicht mehr ständig Sorgen um mich machen muss und wir mehr gemeinsam unternehmen können.
I'm calmer and less anxious. I feel more in control of my life.

My anxiety is much more manageable now. I still worry, but I don't get stuck in worst-case scenarios for days. I feel more confident in my ability to cope, and that has made me happier and more relaxed in general. I'm also more open to trying new things, because I'm less afraid of what might go wrong.
Ich bin entspannter und gönne mir mehr. Das tut mir gut und ich bin zufriedener mit meinem Leben.

My mental health has improved a lot, mainly because of the change in my relationship. I didn't realise how much stress our fights were causing me, and how lonely I felt even though we were together. Since the experience, I feel so much more loved and connected. My partner is my best friend again, like he was at the beginning. That has made me happier and less anxious in general. I also appreciate him and our life together so much more. We've started doing things together again, like cooking and going for long walks on Sundays, and those moments make me deeply happy. When my mother got sick, I was scared and sad, but I didn't feel alone, and I think that protected me from falling into a depression. I'm also more open with my feelings in general, with my friends and family, and that has made all my relationships better.
Less anxious and more present. Life feels lighter.
Ich bin entspannter geworden und habe weniger Verspannungen und Kopfschmerzen. Psychisch fühle ich mich ausgeglichener, weil ich gelernt habe, auf meinen Körper zu hören.

I'm much less anxious about money and the future, and that has improved my mental health a lot. I sleep better and I enjoy my work more. I feel a sense of trust and gratitude that I didn't have before, and I'm more open to opportunities that come my way, even unusual ones.
Hard to say, I don't think it changed much. Maybe a little more relaxed.

Die Erfahrung hat mir in einer Zeit, in der es mir sehr schlecht ging, das Leben gerettet, so dramatisch das auch klingt. Ich hatte damals Suizidgedanken und war in einer tiefen Depression. Ich habe mich wertlos und allein gefühlt. In der Erfahrung habe ich eine Liebe gespürt, die alles verändert hat. Ich habe gespürt, dass ich geliebt werde, von meinen Freunden, von meiner Familie und von etwas Größerem, das ich nicht benennen kann. Ich habe gespürt, dass mein Leben einen Wert hat. Nach der Erfahrung habe ich mir professionelle Hilfe gesucht und eine Therapie begonnen. Die Depression hat sich langsam gebessert, und heute geht es mir gut. Ich bin dankbar für jeden Tag und für die Menschen, die mich durch diese Zeit begleitet haben. Ich bin auch offener geworden, für neue Menschen und neue Erfahrungen, und ich habe das Gefühl, dass mein Leben heute reicher ist als vor der Krise.
Less irritable and more balanced. My family says I'm easier to be around.
It was a positive experience and I felt very connected to my friends, but in terms of mental health, I wouldn't say there was a lasting impact. I was already in a good place.
Ich bin ruhiger und gelassener geworden, und das tut meiner psychischen Gesundheit gut. Ich fühle mich ausgeglichener und zufriedener.

The experience has been life-changing for my mental health. My social anxiety was so severe that it had led to depression and isolation. I spent most of my twenties alone in my flat, working from home and avoiding people. During the experience I felt a deep love for humanity and a sense that I belong, that I'm part of the human family. It sounds grand, but that's how it felt. Since then, my social anxiety has improved dramatically, with the help of therapy. I have friends now, I go out, I've even started dating. My depression has lifted, because I'm not isolated anymore. I feel so much more open to life, to people, to new experiences. I appreciate every connection I make, because I know how lonely I was before. I'm genuinely happy now, most of the time, which I never thought I'd be able to say.
I'm more relaxed and in a better mood generally

Ich habe gelernt, besser auf mich zu achten, und dadurch geht es mir psychisch viel besser. Ich habe weniger Stress, schlafe besser und habe mehr Energie. Ich bin auch zufriedener mit meinem Leben, weil ich mehr Zeit für Dinge habe, die mir wirklich wichtig sind. Ich verstehe jetzt besser, was mir guttut und was nicht.
More stable, less moody

Die Erfahrung hat sich negativ auf meine psychische Gesundheit ausgewirkt. Ich habe danach eine Angststörung entwickelt, die ich vorher nicht hatte, und bin seit über einem Jahr in Behandlung. Es wird langsam besser, aber ich bin noch nicht da, wo ich vorher war.
